description: A slew limiter that softens the jumps in whatever is patched through it, on the rise, the fall or both

params.text: Sets how long the output takes to reach a new value, marked 0 to 10
Picks which direction the limiting works in: Up, Both or Down
Switches the limiting in and out by hand, alongside the control jack

inputs.text: A voltage above 1V here switches the limiting in; below that the input passes through unchanged
